title: Overview: minpoly as the lcm of basis-vector orders
content: Fixing an n×n matrix M makes Kⁿ a K[X]-module (X acts as M). Each vector v has an order ideal vecAnnIdeal M v = {f | f(M)·v = 0}, generated in the PID K[X] by its order polynomial. This file proves the minimal polynomial of M is the lcm of the orders of any basis: at the ideal level span{minpoly K M} is the intersection of the vector annihilators over a spanning family, and the intersection of principal ideals in K[X] is the lcm ideal.
mathContext: span{minpoly K M} = ⨅ᵢ vecAnnIdeal M (bᵢ); ⨅ᵢ span{μᵢ} = span{lcm μ}; hence minpoly K M = Finset.univ.lcm μ.

title: minpoly ideal = intersection of vector annihilators
content: minpoly_span_eq_iInf_vecAnnIdeal: for any family v whose range spans Kⁿ, span{minpoly K M} = ⨅ᵢ vecAnnIdeal M (vᵢ). The ≤ direction is the reused minpoly_ideal_le_vecAnnIdeal. The ≥ direction is the new content: from f killing every spanning vector (aeval M.mulVecLin f (vᵢ) = 0, extracted from the AEval' scalar action) and LinearMap.ext_on_range, the endomorphism aeval M.mulVecLin f is zero; then minpoly.dvd plus minpoly K M = minpoly K M.mulVecLin gives minpoly K M ∣ f.
mathContext: A polynomial annihilates the endomorphism iff it annihilates a spanning set, so the global annihilator is the meet of the per-vector annihilators.

title: Intersection of principal ideals = lcm ideal
content: iInf_span_singleton_eq_lcm: in K[X], ⨅ᵢ span{aᵢ} = span{Finset.univ.lcm a}. This is a one-line membership calculation: x ∈ ⨅ᵢ span{aᵢ} ↔ (∀ i, aᵢ ∣ x) ↔ Finset.univ.lcm a ∣ x ↔ x ∈ span{lcm}, using Finset.lcm_dvd_iff. It is the abstract ring-theoretic fact that turns the meet of orders into a least common multiple.
mathContext: Finset.lcm_dvd_iff: s.lcm f ∣ a ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∣ a.

title: minpoly span = lcm of order generators; existence of monic orders
content: minpoly_span_eq_lcm_of_generators composes the two previous results over a basis b: if μᵢ generates vecAnnIdeal M (bᵢ), then span{minpoly K M} = span{Finset.univ.lcm μ}. exists_monic_generators produces such generators monically: each annihilator ideal is principal (PID), and normalize of a chosen generator is monic (monic_normalize, since the ideal is nonzero — it contains the nonzero minpoly) and generates the same ideal (associated to the original generator).
mathContext: Each vecAnnIdeal M (bᵢ) is principal and nonzero; its normalized generator is the monic order polynomial of bᵢ.

title: minpoly K M = Finset.univ.lcm μ (no monicity needed)
content: minpoly_eq_lcm: the literal polynomial identity for any generators μᵢ of the basis-vector annihilators — strikingly with no monicity hypothesis on the μᵢ. From span{minpoly K M} = span{Finset.univ.lcm μ}, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton gives Associated. The lcm is nonzero (else minpoly would be associated to 0, hence 0) and normalized (Finset.normalize_lcm), so monic_normalize makes it monic; minpoly is monic by Cayley-Hamilton integrality; eq_of_monic_of_associated concludes equality. exists_minpoly_eq_lcm packages the headline existence statement.
mathContext: Two monic associated polynomials are equal; Finset.lcm is automatically normalized, so the generators need not be chosen monic.
